You encounter a young girl while chatting with your girlfriend at your local park.

It's been a year and a half since I started this mod. It started out as a fun little project featuring silly mixes of myself, then it became a tribute — something very important to me. I want to thank all the people and friends who helped me along the way. I love y'all ?

Today, July 26th, is my deceased mother's birthday. She had a long battle with cancer. She always did the best she could, but the disease just became too strong, and she was in so much pain.

It was the most horrible moment of my life.

I wanted to finish the tribute in my mod for her — on this day, I wanted to show her this gift I made for her. But while I was still making it, the news arrived: she was gone.

I'll always love her, and fight for her.

I love you,
Happy birthday Mom. <33

mods.title: FNF: QT Mix (DEMO) [V-SLICE]
mods.description:
QT Mix Cover Mod (Work in Progress)

This project began as a small idea: what if QT stepped into some of the classic Friday Night Funkin’ tracks and gave them her own sound, her own pacing, and her own personality? Over time, that idea grew into a full collection of QT‑styled covers, each one rebuilt from the ground up with new instrumentals, new mixing, and charts designed to feel like they belong in her world. It’s not meant to replace the originals — it’s more like an alternate universe where QT is the one taking the mic during the early weeks.

To be clear, this is not an official QT mod. It’s a fan-made cover pack created for fun, experimentation, and the joy of remixing. Some visual elements or note styles might look unusual because they were made for my own setup, but everything plays normally. If something looks strange, it’s intentional or part of the creative process.

As for QT being playable: this isn’t a full character mod with custom sprites or story content. QT appears through the music itself rather than through cutscenes or animations. Think of it as QT stepping into the soundtrack instead of the dialogue. The focus is on the mixes, the charts, and the overall vibe of each reinterpretation.

The mod is fully compatible with the latest version of V-Slice, including the updated Freeplay system, chart parser, and input logic. Everything has been tested on the newest builds to ensure smooth performance. It also works on mobile versions of V-Slice, so Android players can enjoy the QT Mix tracks without any issues. If you’re running the most recent mobile port, the charts and audio should load correctly and play as intended.

The songs are still being developed, and several are receiving ongoing polish. Some tracks were added a month ago, while others are more recent additions. Expect updates, refinements, and possibly new mixes as the project continues to grow. I’m actively improving the sound design, adjusting chart difficulty, and making sure everything feels consistent across devices.

Current QT Mix Tracks: Bopeebo (QT Mix) Fresh (QT Mix) Spookeez (QT Mix) Pico (QT Mix) Satin Panties (QT Mix) Senpai (QT Mix) Blissful (QT Mix)

More improvements are planned, and I’m continuing to refine the audio, the charts, and the overall presentation. If you enjoy QT’s style or you’re curious about how classic FNF tracks sound when filtered through her energy, feel free to follow the project as it develops. Thanks for checking it out, and I hope you enjoy the mixes as much as I enjoy making them.

mods.title: FNF: SONIC JAM!
mods.description:
Welcome to SONIC JAM

JAMMIN' NEW WEEK

Take on the World's Most Famous Hedgehog in WEEK SONIC, a 3-song original level with songs inspired by the rich soundtracks of Sonic CD, Sonic R,Sonic Adventure, and beyond! Revisit a classic locale, experience dazzling hand-drawn cutscenes, and rhyme at super-sonic speeds! Can you keep up?

PLAYABLE SONIC CAMPAIGN

Dr. Eggman's got a new path to world domination-- the POWER of MUSIC! Using his greatest creation, METAL SONIC, the Doctor's taking over the city's musical culture to harness its unlimited musical power. What's worse... is that they're convinced METAL SONIC is the REAL SONIC! But Sonic's not the slacker type. Take back the city's music and clear Sonic's name through intricately crafted 'Sonic Mixes' of FNF's unforgettable soundtrack. With 10+ remixes lovingly created from the ground up, you can check out a fresh, distinct take on Friday Night Funkin's music inspired by New Jack Swing, RNB, 90's House, Rock, Hip Hop, Chiptune, and many more. Face off against the worst of the worst, bring Metal Sonic's reign to an end, and free the spirit of music in Sonic's campaign.

GO FOR PERFECT

When you're playing as Sonic, simply hitting all the notes won't be enough for those brag-worthy P ranks. On top of beating a song flawlessly, you'll need to style on your enemies with a brand new taunt system. After hitting a combo, you'll be able to chain taunts to the rhythm until your next turn. Pull off a sweet chain, and you'll get crazy bonuses that'll shoot you straight to the top! Every SICK note you hit gets added to your SCORE, so be sure to rack up enough for a massive score bonus at the end. Make a name for yourself on the charts as the most stylish MC alive!

mods.title: Friday Night Funkin' CG5 Edition: Week 1 Remaster
mods.description:
You've finally made it to the big leagues of the music world, but of course there's a twist. To prove your worth, you have to beat the prolific CG5 in a battle of lyrical wits. Show him what you got!


This mod includes the following:

  • CG5 as the opponent
  • Three main songs in EVERY difficulty
  • New background assets
  • OR3O and a Tutorial remix
  • Title Screen remix
  • An extra Freeplay-only cover!
Hope you enjoy! - CG5 Crew :]
mods.author: elikapika

mods.title: Friday Night Funkin: Vs Nonsense (v1.5)
mods.description:
This mod is a celebration of: 
The Classic Nonsense Mod's 4TH YEAR ANNIVERSARY

This mod includes:

  • The songs
  • Scripted Events
  • Remade Sprites
  • New Cutscenes

BF and GF broke down my stupid wall again, and now they're pestering me to rap for them. I have no idea what's with them breaking my wall..

Mechanic:

Mod has a skill check system. Based on how well you do, it's a different outcome

Hope you had fun with the mod again.

NOTE:

  • Download the latest base game version before downloading this
  • This mod is "Naughtyness" supported, so if you're a family-friendly youtuber or just some kid who doesn't wanna get in trouble, then turn "Naughtyness" off in the options (preferences)
  • MOST IMPORTANT OF ALL! Delete the old version of the mod if you're updating instead of overriding to prevent it from breaking n stuff
  • The mod is currently not supported for mobile, so if you're installing on mobile, be prepared to crash probably almost instantly

DOWNLOAD INSTRUCTIONS ARE AVAILABLE IN THE ZIP FILE


IF YOU WANT TO DOWNLOAD THE DLC, BE SURE TO DOWNLOAD THE RECENT VERSION OF THE BASE MOD BEFORE DOWNLOADING THE DLC
(if you already have the base mod, this rule still applies, your version could be outdated)


dev note:

For those who're asking, This'll be the VERY last FNF mod I'll be working on since I don't like the current state of how the nonsense mod V2 ended on. So this is more so just a mod to have some closure for myself personally, leaving with an ending I'm pretty much satisfied with. So boohoo no V10 or smth lmao. I'm still gonna try my best to provide support for the mod on the newer versions of FNF (pc) for archival purposes and yeah.

To those who wonder where I am now, just making dumb little indie games in my itch.io. Feel free to check out my other stuff on there. but other than that, yeh, this mod is the last mod lmao (we don't talk abt V2)

mods.title: Funkin' Mod Menu
mods.description:
V-SLICE MOD MENU Fully functional mod enabling/disabling IN-GAME!! Now on mobile!
    FEATURES:
  • Enable and disable mods to be used
  • Favorite mods, to prevent them from being disabled
  • Expanded view for mods, showcasing all information, accessible via pressing tab or tapping the bottle in the top right
  • Functions on all devices!
